title: iris sanguinea f. stellata
intro: Iris sanguinea f. stellata, commonly known as the dwarf iris or stellate blood iris, is a flowering plant species in the iris family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Iris sanguinea f. stellata include anti-cancer and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and iridoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects, but it is said to contain compounds like 6,7-dihydroxybergamottin and 6,7-dihydroxybergamottin acetate, which contribute to its medicinal value.
